rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Donatella (hybrid tea, Meilland Richardier 2009)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 2009).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2011 as 'Donatella'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, deep pink center. [Apricot blend.] Strong fragrance. up to 60 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, quartered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Source: Website Alterarosa. Participant in 2011 competition.
Participated in the 2012 Glasgow Trials.
